# Orbit Runner

Control a small ship navigating a field of rotating asteroids on an HTML canvas. The ship can thrust and rotate. Collect floating fuel cells to extend your run. **Lose condition:** crash into any asteroid or run out of fuel.

<content>
1: // Orbit Runner – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // ----- Audio setup -----
11:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
12:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
13:   let thrustOsc = null;
14:   function startThrustSound() {
15:     if (thrustOsc) return;
16:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
18:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     thrustOsc.start();
22:   }
23:   function stopThrustSound() {
24:     if (thrustOsc) {
25:       thrustOsc.stop();
26:       thrustOsc.disconnect();
27:       thrustOsc = null;
28:     }
29:   }
30:   function playCollectSound() {
31:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
32:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
33:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.03, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
38:   }
39:   function playCrashSound() {
40:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
41:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
42:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
43:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
44:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
45:     osc.start();
46:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
47:   }
48: 
49:   // ----- Game entities -----
50:   const ship = {
51:     x: W / 2,
52:     y: H / 2,
53:     r: 10,
54:     angle: 0,
55:     vx: 0,
56:     vy: 0,
57:     thrust: 0.1,
58:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
59:     fuel: 100,
60:   };
61: 
62:   // star field for background
63:   const stars = [];
64:   const starCount = 120;
65:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
66:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5 });
67:   }
68: 
69:   const asteroids = [];
70:   const asteroidCount = 8;
71:   const center = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 };
72:   for (let i = 0; i < asteroidCount; i++) {
73:     const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
74:     const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / asteroidCount;
75:     const speed = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4;
76:     // use texture‑like random polygon radius
77:     asteroids.push({ radius, angle, speed, r: 15 + Math.random() * 10 });
78:   }
79: 
80:   const fuels = [];
81:   const fuelCount = 5;
82:   for (let i = 0; i < fuelCount; i++) {
83:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: 6, value: 30 });
84:   }
85: 
86:   // ----- Input -----
87:   const keys = {};
88:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
89:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
90: 
91:   // ----- Helpers -----
92:   function circleCollision(ax, ay, ar, bx, by, br) {
93:     const dx = ax - bx;
94:     const dy = ay - by;
95:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < (ar + br) * (ar + br);
96:   }
97: 
98:   // ----- Main loop -----
99:   let gameOver = false;
100:   function update() {
101:     if (gameOver) return;
102:     // ensure audio context is running after first interaction
103:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
104:     // controls
105:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
106:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
107:     const thrusting = keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0;
108:     if (thrusting) {
109:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
110:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
111:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.2);
112:       startThrustSound();
113:     } else {
114:       stopThrustSound();
115:     }
116:     // fuel drain over time
117:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.05);
118:     // move ship
119:     ship.x += ship.vx;
120:     ship.y += ship.vy;
121:     // simple friction
122:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
123:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
124:     // wrap around edges
125:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += W;
126:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x -= W;
127:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += H;
128:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y -= H;
129: 
130:     // update asteroids (orbit around center)
131:     for (const a of asteroids) {
132:       a.angle += a.speed * 0.01;
133:       a.x = center.x + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.radius;
134:       a.y = center.y + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.radius;
135:       // collision with ship
136:       if (circleCollision(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, a.x, a.y, a.r)) {
137:         gameOver = true;
138:         stopThrustSound();
139:         playCrashSound();
140:       }
141:     }
142: 
143:     // fuel cells collection
144:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
145:       const f = fuels[i];
146:       if (circleCollision(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, f.x, f.y, f.r)) {
147:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + f.value);
148:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
149:         playCollectSound();
150:       }
151:     }
152:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
153:   }
154: 
155:   function draw() {
156:     // background gradient
157:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
158:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
159:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
160:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
161:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
162:     // stars
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
164:     for (const s of stars) {
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:       ctx.fill();
168:     }
169:     // ship with thrust flame
170:     ctx.save();
171:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
172:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
173:     // ship body
174:     ctx.beginPath();
175:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
176:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
177:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
178:     ctx.closePath();
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
180:     ctx.fill();
181:     // thrust flame
182:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
183:       ctx.beginPath();
184:       ctx.moveTo(-8, -4);
185:       ctx.lineTo(-14, 0);
186:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 4);
187:       ctx.closePath();
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
189:       ctx.fill();
190:     }
191:     ctx.restore();
192:     // asteroids with radial gradient shading
193:     for (const a of asteroids) {
194:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
195:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
196:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
197:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
200:       ctx.fill();
201:     }
202:     // fuel cells with glow
203:     for (const f of fuels) {
204:       const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, f.r);
205:       glow.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
206:       glow.addColorStop(1, '#880');
207:       ctx.fillStyle = glow;
208:       ctx.beginPath();
209:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
210:       ctx.fill();
211:     }
212:     // UI
213:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
214:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
215:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
216:     if (gameOver) {
217:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
218:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
219:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 120, H / 2);
220:     }
221:   }
222: 
223:   function loop() {
224:     update();
225:     draw();
226:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
227:   }
228:   loop();
229: })();

(End of file - total 229 lines)
</content>
